biography.plain_text: Miroslav Výboh is a Slovak businessman from Zvolen who built his fortune through the arms-trading company Willing. He subsequently headed Mayfair Assets and became chairman and a major shareholder of MiddleCap Group, formed through a merger of investment and advisory businesses. His business career has also encompassed commercial property development.

long_biography.plain_text:
As MiddleCap's chairman, Miroslav Výboh advocated moving venture investments beyond seed-stage companies towards businesses with revenue and operating results. He also wanted acquisitions in construction and facilities management, alongside commodity investments intended to offset the development business's economic cycle. His proposals called for the group's analysts to contribute more directly to acquisition decisions.

Away from business, Výboh competed for Scuderia Praha in Ferrari Challenge's Coppa Shell Am class. He fitted simulator sessions around work and relied on his coach to refine his driving. His son Matúš raced in Trofeo Pirelli Am; in 2020, the elder Výboh was still pursuing his first podium.
